source: User D1–D10 message in current conversation

decisions.title: Splitting the work
decisions.choice: Four reasoning roles for requirements, design, implementation/testing and independent review, with deterministic testing and release control
decisions.suggested_reason: This separates responsibilities without the overhead of six separate reasoning agents, and allows the A1 and A2 artifacts to be reused
decisions.rejected_reason: It mixes implementation, verification and review context, making independent review less credible

decisions.title: Control flow
decisions.choice: Deterministic state machine with explicit stage gates and two total review rounds
decisions.suggested_reason: The six required stages and retry boundaries should be enforced by code rather than model discretion
decisions.rejected_reason: It could skip checks or repeatedly retry without respecting the budget
decisions.accepted_drawback: More controller code and less flexibility.

decisions.title: Handoffs
decisions.choice: Full validated specification and design artifacts for implementation, and a separate restricted reviewer context
decisions.suggested_reason: This preserves acceptance criteria and architecture constraints across hand-offs
decisions.rejected: Passing complete conversations to every agent
decisions.rejected_reason: It wastes context and could bias the reviewer
decisions.vague_issue_rule: For vague issues, the A1 readiness gate must verify that acceptance criteria are testable. If critical requirements remain ambiguous, save the draft spec and clarification questions, stop with needs_clarification, and resume only after an authorized clarification. Do not invent requirements.

decisions.title: State
decisions.choice: Immutable execution artifacts, unique attempt identifiers, hashes and a durable run-to-PR index
decisions.suggested_reason: Failures and interrupted runs should remain traceable, while restarts must check existing branches and PRs to prevent duplicates
decisions.rejected: Using Actions cache as the authoritative state
decisions.rejected_reason: Cache availability and retention are unsuitable for recovery and grading evidence

decisions.title: Tools
decisions.choice: Restricted model-broker tools with isolated patch application, test execution and a separate GitHub publisher
decisions.suggested_reason: Untrusted generated code and tests must not execute with provider credentials or repository write authority
decisions.rejected: One general shell agent holding all credentials
decisions.rejected_reason: It creates unnecessary exposure to malicious code or prompt injection
decisions.accepted_drawback: Additional validation, isolation and artifact transfers.

decisions.title: Models
decisions.choice: Defer exact hosted provider, model and reasoning effort
decisions.suggested_reason: Local Codex authentication does not establish API availability or cost controls within GitHub Actions. Select a supported model after verifying provider access and a hard spending cap
decisions.rejected: Choosing an unverified model or silently changing models across experiments
decisions.rejected_reason: This risks failed hosted execution and confounded comparisons
decisions.accepted_drawback: Hosted model-driven runs remain blocked until the model configuration is approved.

decisions.title: Stage checks
decisions.choice: Deterministic structural checks, real build and test execution, exact-commit CI, plus targeted semantic checks
decisions.suggested_reason: Tests and recorded CI status provide stronger evidence than agent-generated success statements
decisions.rejected: Trusting an agent's claim that its stage passed
decisions.rejected_reason: It does not prove which commands ran or which commit was tested
decisions.accepted_drawback: Additional verification time and imperfect defect coverage.

decisions.title: Reviewer independence
decisions.choice: Fresh independent reviewer context, separate prompt, sanitized latest PR source and diff, with no push tools
decisions.suggested_reason: The reviewer must evaluate the actual change without relying on implementation reasoning, and seeded cases can measure its mistakes
decisions.rejected: The implementer reviewing its own work in the same conversation
decisions.rejected_reason: Its previous assumptions can influence the outcome
decisions.accepted_drawback: Additional cost, latency and possible false positives or missed defects.

decisions.title: Safety and failures
decisions.choice: Provider spending cap, enforced timeouts, retry budgets, model-call limits and fail-closed errors
decisions.suggested_reason: Trusted code must enforce safety limits because prompt instructions alone cannot guarantee them
decisions.rejected: Unlimited retries with prompt-only safety instructions
decisions.rejected_reason: This permits uncontrolled execution or spending
decisions.accepted_drawback: Some legitimate difficult tasks may stop unfinished.

decisions.title: Triggers
decisions.choice: Authorized maintainer-applied autose label or exact /autose issue comment, with permission checks and duplicate-event handling
decisions.suggested_reason: This provides a convenient GitHub trigger without allowing arbitrary issue authors to initiate costly work
decisions.rejected: Allowing every issue author to trigger the workflow
decisions.rejected_reason: Issue authorship does not establish current repository write permissions
decisions.accepted_drawback: Additional authorization, concurrency and idempotency logic.
